stem: Which of these best states the poem’s theme?

options.label: A
options.text: Although children may disagree with their elders, family bonds remain strong.

options.label: B
options.text: Sentiment is a waste of time and energy.

options.label: C
options.text: Progress can be judged only by an impartial observer.

options.label: D
options.text: Even in the midst of historic change, some things remain constant.
